<img width="1000" height="300" alt="banner" src="https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a2cc85de-421c-4b5f-8812-eb6a12f14a1b" />![Upl<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1000 300" width="1000" height="300" role="img" aria-label="Shaliah Fricas — ur favorite engineer">
  <defs>
    <style>
      @font-face {
        font-family: 'PSP';
        src: url(data:font/woff2;base64,) format('woff2');
      }
      .st { animation: tw 3s ease-in-out infinite; }
      @keyframes tw { 0%,100% { opacity:.25 } 50% { opacity:1 } }
      .hp { animation: beat 2.6s ease-in-out infinite; transform-box: fill-box; transform-origin: center; }
      @keyframes beat { 0%,86%,100% { transform:scale(1) } 91% { transform:scale(1.22) } }
      .name { font-family:'PSP',monospace; font-size:34px; fill:#ffc93c; }
      .tag  { font-family:'PSP',monospace; font-size:11px; fill:#34e1d4; letter-spacing:1px; }
      .sub  { font-family:'PSP',monospace; font-size:9px;  fill:#9aa8c8; letter-spacing:1px; }
      .lbl  { font-family:'PSP',monospace; font-size:7px;  fill:#ff2b2b; letter-spacing:1px; }
      .shoot { animation: sh 7s linear infinite; }
      @keyframes sh { 0%,72% { opacity:0; transform:translate(0,0) } 76% { opacity:1 } 88%,100% { opacity:0; transform:translate(190px,105px) } }
    </style>
    <radialGradient id="neb1" cx="50%" cy="50%">

    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="0" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#05060f"/><stop offset="55%" stop-color="#04060f"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#070b1c"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="beam" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff2b2b" stop-opacity=".85"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ff2b2b" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="trail" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity=".9"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffffff" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </linearGradient>

![Missions](https://img.shields.io/badge/MISSIONS-ffc93c?style=for-the-badge&labelColor=05070f)

> ### `[ ACTIVE ]` Sensor Reliability in Autonomous Robots
> **ICARUS Lab · McNair Scholars Program** — Mentor: Prof. Ioannis Zografopoulos
>
> How do sensor-based navigation systems in autonomous robots respond to manipulated or incorrect sensor input — and how do we make them more reliable? Testing a **TurtleBot3 Burger** (ROS/ROS2, LiDAR) under delayed, noisy, and spoofed sensor conditions using **Opal-RT** hardware-in-the-loop, working toward validation and filtering methods for safer **assistive robotics**.
>
> `TurtleBot3` `ROS2` `LiDAR` `Opal-RT` `Python`

> ### `[ COMPLETE ]` Hybrid RF / Optical Indoor Localization
> **UCaN Lab** — Advisor: Prof. Michael Rahaim
>
> Fusing **RF fingerprinting** with **Visible Light Positioning** on an SDR testbed so localization stays reliable where GPS fails. My portion was the **machine learning**: collecting and analyzing wireless signal data in MATLAB, and modeling localization and environment classification.
>
> **Result:** 85.2% motion-classification accuracy at a 2 ms window vs. 51.0% at 20 ms.
>
> `MATLAB` `Python` `SDR` `GNU Radio` `OWC/VLP`

> ### `[ ACCEPTED ]` 2027 MassRobotics Competition
> **UMass Robotics &amp; Engineering Club** — Robotics, Automation &amp; Controls
>
> Building with the team for the 2027 run. Mission in progress — no achievement until it's earned.
